title: Wendy's-Style Hot Dog Buns
description: Soft, golden buns made for loading up with your favourite hot dogs — eight generously sized rolls.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lukewarm milk, sugar, and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add bread flour, salt, and melted butter. Mix until a rough dough forms.
Knead for 8–10 minutes until the dough is smooth, soft, and springy.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for approximately 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces, approximately 105–110 g each. Roll each into a 25 cm log and pinch seams underneath.
Place shaped buns on a lined baking tray, cover, and rest for 30–45 minutes until puffed.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until pale golden.
Cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.

notes.title: Shaping
notes.content: Use slightly floured hands and work surface for easier shaping. Pinch the seams firmly underneath to prevent the buns from unrolling during baking.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container for 2–3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Thaw and warm before using.
